adminSettings.title: Admin settings
adminSettings.guardrailsSub: Blacklisted terms that block and log restricted content
adminSettings.guardrailsHint: Topics or answers matching these terms are blocked and logged for review. Saving here replaces the full list — include every category you want kept, not just new ones.
adminSettings.externalModelsSub: Cloud API keys, model version, provider, rate limits
adminSettings.externalModelsHint: Optional. Applied immediately without a restart.
adminSettings.skillsSub: Standing per-user instructions and reusable skills
adminSettings.skillsHint: Standing instructions applied to every generation for a user. A skill needs a name, a short description, and instructions.
adminSettings.generalSub: Prompt optimization, Arabic output, allowed formats, frameworks
adminSettings.logsSub: Unhandled errors caught by the app, for admin monitoring
adminSettings.logsHint: Every unhandled error the backend catches lands here for review.
adminSettings.tokenRateLimit: Token rate limit per user (per hour)
adminSettings.noSkills: No skills for this user yet.

adminSettings.saveFailed: Failed to save — please try again.
adminSettings.resolveFailed: Could not mark this as resolved — please try again.
adminSettings.retentionSub: Retention periods and authenticated-user data deletion
adminSettings.retentionHint: Set how many days operational records are kept. Leave blank to retain indefinitely.
adminSettings.deleteMyDataHint: Deletes your history, feedback, jobs, tasks, telemetry, and moderation flags. The deletion audit record is retained.
adminSettings.deleteDataConfirm: Delete all data associated with your authenticated account? This cannot be undone.
adminSettings.deleteDataFailed: Could not delete your data — please try again.
adminSettings.modelModerationSub: Classifier-based moderation in addition to blocked terms
adminSettings.modelModerationHint: This optional classifier runs only after the blocked-term check passes.
adminSettings.enableModelModerationHint: Catches restricted content that keyword matching may miss.
adminSettings.fallbackProvidersSub: Ordered backup providers for failed generations
adminSettings.fallbackHint: If the selected provider is unavailable, these providers are tried in order.
adminSettings.presentonHint: Presenton is optional. When unavailable, presentation export continues through the local pipeline.
adminSettings.webSearchSub: Tavily grounding and curated source allowlist
adminSettings.webSearchHint: Web grounding is optional. Missing or unavailable Tavily access does not block generation.
adminSettings.bulkImportHint: Paste a numbered category line followed by alternating source-name and URL lines.

adminSettings.mcpServersSub: Admin-managed catalog of external tool servers
adminSettings.mcpServersHint: Manage the catalog users can connect to. OAuth and shared API-key servers are supported.
adminSettings.noMcpServers: No MCP servers in the catalog.
